meta.project: SIH26107 - BIS Standards & Certification Chatbot (Knowledge Base)
meta.generated_note_hinglish: Yeh knowledge base do jagah se bana hai: (1) aapki di hui bis_complete_dataset.csv file ke 2291 IS standards (is_number + title + BIS ka internal preview reference), jisme maine sirf ek heuristic 'category' tag add kiya hai; (2) BIS ke official portal (bis.gov.in, standards.bis.gov.in, manakonline.in) se live web-search karke nikaali gayi certification process, testing labs, hallmark, complaints aur FAQ ki jaankari.
important_limitations_hinglish: CSV file me product_category, scope_summary, price, aur status (Active/Withdrawn) columns pehle se KHAALI the (BIS ke live listing scrape me yeh fields nahi aa paayi thi) - maine inhe khud se invent nahi kiya.

'category_heuristic' field maine title ke keywords se khud classify kiya hai (Electrical, Chemicals, Food, etc.) - yeh BIS ka official Divisional Council classification NAHI hai, sirf filtering/search ke liye ek helpful guess hai. 342 standards (~15%) 'General / Other Engineering' me hain kyunki unke title se clear category nahi pata chali - MVP demo ke liye theek hai, production ke liye BIS ke 'Know Your Standard' tool se verify karna better hoga.

Price aur Active/Withdrawn status BIS ke naye portal (standards.bis.gov.in) par per-standard encrypted session ID se dikhta hai (static/bulk scrape possible nahi is tarah), isliye yeh 2291 standards ke liye individually fill nahi kar paaya. Standard ka real-time price/status check karne ke liye 'lookup_instructions' section dekho - wahan exact official links diye hain jinhe apna scraper/API integration wire kar sakte ho.

PDF preview link ka format bhi purana scheme tha (BIS_Preview.aspx?id=...) jo CSV me tha - BIS ne portal upgrade kar diya hai, ab standard-details ek encrypted per-session ID leta hai jo static URL se nahi bantam. Isliye maine raw reference field ko 'bis_preview_ref' naam se as-is rakha hai (future scraper isko match kar sakta hai), aur sahi current lookup ka tareeka alag se bataya hai.
sources: https://standardsbis.bsbedge.com (official e-Sale portal for IS/SP, appointed to BSB Edge Pvt Ltd)

module_1_indian_standards_search.description_hinglish: User query jaise 'AC banane ke liye kaunsa BIS standard chahiye' ya 'IS 14643 kiske liye hai' - is module se IS number, title, aur heuristic category milegi. Price / official PDF / Active-Withdrawn status live lookup se aani chahiye (neeche lookup_instructions dekho), isliye woh fields yahan har standard ke against nahi hain.
module_1_indian_standards_search.category_distribution_note_hinglish: category_heuristic keyword-matching se aayi hai (e.g. 'cement'->Civil Engineering, 'electric'->Electrical & Power). Chatbot UI me ise 'Suggested category' jaisa dikhana, 'Official BIS category' nahi.

lookup_instructions_hinglish.know_your_standard_tool: https://standards.bis.gov.in/website/know-your-standards - IS number ya keyword daal ke ek standard ka PDF, amendments, licenses list, testing labs list, aur committee details milte hain (yeh session-based hai, isliye scraping ke liye headless browser / official BIS API access chahiye hoga, simple static URL se nahi hoga).
lookup_instructions_hinglish.buy_or_download_standard: https://standardsbis.bsbedge.com - BIS ne Indian Standards (IS) aur Special Publications (SP) bechne ka kaam BSB Edge Pvt Ltd ko diya hai. Standards jo Quality Control Order (QCO) ke under mandatory hain, unhe BIS free-of-cost dikhata hai; baaki standards paid hain aur price standard ke size/pages ke hisaab se alag-alag hota hai (isliye ek fixed number nahi de sakta - kisi bhi ek standard ka fixed price bolna galat info hogi).
lookup_instructions_hinglish.crs_registered_electronics_check: https://www.crsbis.in/BIS/Lims_registrationc.do?hmode=getLimsData - CRS (electronics/IT) ke registered manufacturers/products check karne ke liye.

module_2_certification_process_guide.description_hinglish: User query: 'Mujhe BIS certification kaise milega', 'License ke liye kaise apply karu'

ISI_Mark_Product_Certification.who: Domestic Indian manufacturers - voluntary standards ke liye optional, QCO-notified (mandatory) products ke liye compulsory
procedures: Simplified Procedure - manufacturer ke paas pehle se BIS-recognised lab ka test report ho to yeh fast route hai
Normal Procedure - jab koi recognised lab available na ho ya woh standard ke liye pehla license ho India me; testing BIS khud factory-based ya sample bhej ke karwata hai
steps_hinglish: MANAK Online portal par manufacturer registration + OTP verification
Applicable IS number identify karo (product ke liye kaunsa standard lagta hai)
Application + documents + application fee submit karo online
Factory inspection (third-party inspection agency BIS ki taraf se)
Sample testing (BIS lab ya BIS-recognised lab me)
Test report satisfactory hone par license grant + marking fee + annual license fee
License milne ke baad product par ISI mark use kar sakte ho + periodic surveillance visits hote rahenge
typical_documents: Certificate of Incorporation / business registration proof
List of machinery with calibration certificates
In-house/BIS-recognised lab test reports (agar simplified procedure use kar rahe ho)
ISI_Mark_Product_Certification.approx_fee_breakup_hinglish: Yeh figures multiple certification-consultancy sources se average nikaale gaye hain, BIS ki official per-product fee schedule alag ho sakti hai - exact figure ke liye https://www.bis.gov.in/product-certification/product-certification-fee/ hi authoritative hai: Application fee ~₹1,000 (non-refundable) + Processing/marking fee ~₹2,000 + Factory inspection fee ~₹7,000 + product-specific lab testing charges (varies a lot by product) + annual license fee (renewed yearly).
ISI_Mark_Product_Certification.typical_timeline_hinglish: Simplified Procedure: ~30-45 din. Normal Procedure (naya lab test/factory-based testing included): ~40-60 din. In dono me delay tab hota hai jab sample fail ho jaaye - fresh sample + re-test se time badh jaata hai.
ISI_Mark_Product_Certification.validity: License normally 1 saal ke liye valid hota hai, phir annual renewal (fee + surveillance ke saath).

FMCS_Foreign_Manufacturers_Certification.who: Foreign/overseas manufacturers jo apne product par ISI mark chahte hain India export ke liye
FMCS_Foreign_Manufacturers_Certification.key_requirement: Ek Authorised Indian Representative (AIR) nominate karna zaroori hai - registered Indian entity ya resident jo BIS ke saath sab communication handle kare, aur ek AIR normally sirf ek foreign manufacturer represent kar sakta hai
FMCS_Foreign_Manufacturers_Certification.typical_timeline_hinglish: ~4 se 6 mahine (domestic ISI se zyada lambi process, kyunki factory inspection aur documentation cross-border coordinate karna padta hai).

module_2_certification_process_guide.mandatory_vs_voluntary_hinglish: BIS certification scheme by default VOLUNTARY hai. Lekin jo products Quality Control Order (QCO) ke under notify ho chuke hain unke liye ISI mark/CRS registration compulsory hai - bina certification manufacture, import, ya sell karna BIS Act 2016 ke under punishable offence hai. 2026 tak 400+ product categories QCO ke under aa chuke hain (electronics, electrical goods, steel/TMT bars, cement, toys, helmets, packaged drinking water, furniture, footwear, ACs, water heaters, washing machines, kai industrial chemicals waghera).

BIS khud ek static city-wise CSV/JSON publish nahi karta - unke apne 4 live search tools hain jo hamesha up-to-date rehte hain. Chatbot ko yahi official tools ko live query karna chahiye (ya periodically inhe crawl/cache karna), kyunki labs list add/remove/suspend hoti rehti hai.

BIS-Empanelled laboratories (Group-2, mostly govt labs jinhe BIS empanel karta hai)

module_3_testing_laboratories_directory.implementation_suggestion_hinglish: Chatbot ke backend me ek scheduled job rakho jo lims.bis.gov.in ke labs list ko periodically (e.g. weekly) fetch/cache kare, taaki user ko city/state + product-category se filter karke fast jawab mil sake, PDF file har baar re-download kiye bina.

module_4_hallmark_information.description_hinglish: User query: 'Gold jewellery pe hallmark kaise check karu', '916 gold ka kya matlab hai'
module_4_hallmark_information.what_is_hallmark_hinglish: BIS Hallmark gold aur silver jewellery ki purity certify karta hai. Gold jewellery ke liye 2000 se, silver jewellery ke liye 2005 se yeh scheme chal rahi hai. Har hallmark me BIS logo, gold ka purity grade, aur ek 6-digit alphanumeric HUID (Hallmark Unique Identification) number hota hai.
how_to_verify_hinglish: BIS CARE app download karo (Android/iOS, free) - 'Verify HUID' me jewellery ke HUID number daalo, purity, jeweller ka naam/address, aur hallmarking status turant mil jaayega.
ISI-marked ya CRS-registered kisi bhi product ka license/registration number bhi isi app me 'Verify Licence Details' ya 'Verify R-Number under CRS' se check ho sakta hai.
App 12 languages support karta hai (10 regional + Hindi + English), OTP se mobile number register karna padta hai.
fake_vs_real_indicators_hinglish: Genuine hallmark me clear BIS logo + purity grade (jaise 22K916) + 6-digit HUID hota hai - agar HUID BIS CARE app me verify na ho ya jeweller details match na kare, to woh fake/misused mark ho sakta hai.
Sirf 'BIS' likha hona proof nahi hai - HUID app se verify karna hi reliable tareeka hai.
module_4_hallmark_information.complaint_process_hinglish: BIS CARE app ke 'Complaints' section me 'Misuse of Hallmark' ya sub-standard product select karke evidence (photo/bill) ke saath complaint file kar sakte ho, jisse ek complaint number milta hai follow-up ke liye. Yeh CMED (Complaints Management and Enforcement Department) ke paas jaata hai.

module_7_faqs.question: BIS kya hai?
module_7_faqs.answer_hinglish: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) India ka National Standards Body hai, BIS Act 2016 ke under. Yeh products, processes aur services ke liye Indian Standards banata hai, aur Product Certification, System Certification, Hallmarking, aur Compulsory Registration jaisi schemes chalata hai. Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution ke under aata hai. Isse pehle yeh Indian Standards Institution (ISI) ke naam se 1947 se kaam kar raha tha.

module_7_faqs.question: BIS aur ISO mein kya fark hai?
module_7_faqs.answer_hinglish: BIS India ka apna national standards body hai jo Indian Standards banata aur certify karta hai. ISO (International Organization for Standardization) ek global body hai jo international standards banata hai. BIS India ki taraf se ISO me participate karta hai aur kayi Indian Standards ISO standards ke saath harmonize/adopt kiye jaate hain (isliye kai IS numbers ke saath corresponding ISO number bhi likha milta hai, jaise is CSV me dikh raha hai).

module_7_faqs.question: Standard aur certification mein difference?
module_7_faqs.answer_hinglish: Standard (IS number) ek document hai jo batata hai product/process kaise design, test, ya manufacture hona chahiye. Certification woh process hai jisse BIS verify karta hai ki tumhara actual product us standard ko follow karta hai - tab jaake ISI mark ya registration milta hai.

module_7_faqs.question: BIS CARE app kaise use karu?
module_7_faqs.answer_hinglish: Play Store/App Store se free download karo, mobile number se OTP register karo, phir product par likha license/HUID/R-number daal ke authenticity verify karo. Complaints file karne ke liye 'Complaints' section use karo. App me BIS labs, offices, aur standards ki info bhi milti hai.

module_7_faqs.question: Free mein standards kaise dekhu?
module_7_faqs.answer_hinglish: Jo standards Quality Control Orders (mandatory certification) ke under aate hain, unhe BIS free-of-cost view/download karne deta hai. Baaki (voluntary) standards ke liye official e-Sale portal (standardsbis.bsbedge.com) se kharidna padta hai - price standard ke hisaab se alag hota hai.

module_7_faqs.question: ISI mark mandatory hai ya voluntary?
module_7_faqs.answer_hinglish: By default BIS certification voluntary hai. Lekin jo products government ke Quality Control Order (QCO) list me notify ho chuke hain (jaise cement, steel, toys, helmets, packaged drinking water, electronics ke kai items), unke liye ISI mark/CRS registration LEGALLY MANDATORY hai - bina certification bechna BIS Act 2016 ke under punishable hai.

module_7_faqs.question: License kitne saal ke liye valid hota hai?
module_7_faqs.answer_hinglish: Normally 1 saal, phir annual renewal karna padta hai (fee + surveillance visit ke saath).
